Before work begins

Clarity on the work.
Clarity on the commitment.

We agree the scope, responsibilities, delivery stages and acceptance checks. We confirm required integrations, access, data permissions and operating requirements.

Pricing follows the agreed scope. Licensing, configuration, custom engineering and ongoing support are set out clearly in the proposal.

We also agree what to measure, so your team can see whether the intended change is happening.
